title: SEHFS: Structural Entropy-Guided High-Order Correlation Learning for Multi-View Multi-Label Feature Selection
abstract: arXiv:2603.03022v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: In recent years, multi-view multi-label learning (MVML) has attracted extensive attention due to its close alignment to real-world scenarios. Information-theoretic methods have gained prominence for learning nonlinear correlations. However, two key challenges persist: first, features in real-world data commonly exhibit high-order structural correlations, but existing information-theoretic methods struggle to learn such correlations; second, commonly relying on heuristic optimization, information-theoretic methods are prone to converging to local optima. translated_title: SEHFS：面向多视图多标签特征选择的结构熵引导高阶相关性学习
translated_abstract: 近年来，多视图多标签学习（MVML）因与真实世界场景高度契合而受到广泛关注。信息论方法因能够学习非线性相关性而日益受到重视。然而，仍存在两个关键挑战：首先，真实世界数据中的特征通常表现出高阶结构相关性，但现有的信息论方法难以学习此类相关性；其次，信息论方法通常依赖启发式优化，容易收敛到局部最优。为解决这两个挑战，我们提出了一种名为“面向多视图多标签特征选择的结构熵引导高阶相关性学习”（SEHFS）的新方法。SEHFS的核心思想是将特征图转换为结构熵最小化的编码树，量化高阶依赖关系的信息代价，从而学习高阶特征相关性。
tldr: 提出SEHFS方法，通过将特征图转换为结构熵最小化的编码树来量化高阶依赖的信息代价，从而学习高阶特征相关性，解决了多视图多标签特征选择中现有信息论方法难以捕捉高阶结构相关性且易陷入局部最优的问题。
en_tdlr: The proposed SEHFS method converts the feature graph into a structural-entropy-minimizing encoding tree to quantify the information cost of high-order dependencies, thereby learning high-order feature correlations and addressing the challenges that existing information-theoretic feature selection methods struggle to capture high-order structural correlations and are prone to local optima.
